checkpoints.description: [1/3] Close the structural losses recorded in ADR-039: milestone 1 = foreign inlining inside frame-path functions (the rbp prologue never sets self.current, so _foreign_inline_target refuses every copy in a function with more than six slots); milestone 2 = home reuse for frame functions (inner scopes re-register slots whose outer bindings died); milestone 3 = loop-induction strength reduction (mandelbrot's px * 16384 - 4194304 and py * 24576 become running values)

impact_assessment.why: contract: no language-surface change, only codegen lowering; the recorded user rules re-run the full benchmark gate after every compiler change and ship test+benchmark twins for new constructs; dependency: extends the committed foreign-inline machinery (e9f84e4) and the assembler zf summary (9126db4); concurrency: single-threaded codegen, no new shared state beyond the existing assembler fields; state: ledger and decisions.md stay append-only
impact_assessment.benefits: mandelbrot and any program whose main or workers exceed six home slots currently compile every inner-loop value to frame memory (13 of 25 inner-loop instructions in mandelbrot are rbp traffic); foreign inlining inside frame functions removes call overhead there; strength reduction removes a multiply per row loop; measured targets: mandelbrot 14.6 vs C 10.7 ms and the general case of 7+-slot functions
impact_assessment.risks: contract: mis-inlining in frame functions must not read stale argument registers (the guarded shapes are call-free, loop-free, trap-free callees with parameters bound to spilled homes); dependency: pushes of spill homes inside a frame body shift rsp, so copy emission must stay push/pop balanced exactly as in leaf callers; concurrency: none; state: benchmark history changes only through the recorded gate
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first byte-shape tests pin when the fallback call stays (rebinds-parameter callees, overshoot slots), e2e twins pin outputs, the full suite and --save --compare gate run before every commit exactly as in the delivered milestones, and ADR-040 records any ab

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Phase 4: milestone 1 verified - frame-path functions raise body state (self.current etc.) so foreign inlining works inside 7+-slot functions, and the copy refusal drops self.depth while keeping self.temporaries (a stack park survives a call-free copy; a register temporary does not); failing-first FramePathInlineTest + FramePathRebindFallbackTest + FramePathInlineValueTest e2e; 754 tests + 39 subtests green; gate exit 0 twice (flags were drift); ADR-040

[2/3] Stack-parameter foreign copies: a six-argument call-free bind-once callee copies instead of paying the stack-call path; args 5-6 park in r11/r10 and bind into guest homes at copy entry; home-reuse-by-scope-death closed (mandelbrot homes all live across the inner loop). 785 tests OK; gate --save --compare exit 0, many_params 44.2->28.9 ms (-34.5%). ADR-041. README rows for hex_io/many_params added.

impact_assessment.why: many_params measured 42-44 ms against C 7.8 ms: the biggest board loss traces to the foreign-copy form refusing >4-argument callees, so every call paid callee home saves plus caller outgoing-area churn
impact_assessment.benefits: six-argument helper calls inline like gcc's -O2 shapes; measured -34.5% on many_params; machinery general (rebinds form included), fallback preserved
impact_assessment.risks: contract: copy form now covers 5-6 params,  pins moved to a calling callee; dependency: none (standard library only); concurrency: none; state: benchmark history append-only, ledger checkpoint appended
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first calls_of + e2e value twins; full suite; gate twice-tolerant noise discharge per ADR-031; stack-call machinery still pinned and reachable by non-copyable callees

impact_assessment.benefits: one memory-operand instruction per frame self-update, shape-generic across all programs; correctness preserved by construction for calling/trapping right sides
impact_assessment.risks: contract: memory forms never assert ZF for a register; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none beyond append-only history
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first machine encodings, byte-shape tests and an e2e twin; full suite; gate noise discharge per ADR-031

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Planning: rework the positional slot-to-home mapping (self.homes indexed by slot) into an explicit home_of map so home assignment can follow loop depth and live ranges instead of declaration order; M1 identity refactor (no behavior change), M2 loop-depth preference for frame functions (mandelbrot inner loop), M3 evaluated 8-home ABI vs live-range assignment against measured value; each milestone passes the full suite, the --save --compare gate and its own failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: mandelbrot's inner loop keeps 5-6 of its 7-11 live values in frame memory purely because the first six DECLARED slots take the six registers; the board records 14.4-14.9 vs C 10.3 and nqueens 25 vs 22 as allocation-bound losses
impact_assessment.benefits: home assignment becomes a decision the generator makes per function, not a positional default; unlocked levers: loop-depth preference, live-range assignment, and a potential 8-home ABI evaluated on evidence
impact_assessment.risks: contract: self.homes is positional in ~20 sites (saves, clear-frame, guest tuples, shadow copies, hoist spares, plans) - the map must carry identical ordering semantics at each; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: none; state: benchmark history append-only
impact_assessment.mitigation: M1 is a pure identity refactor verified byte-identical by the full suite and gate before any preference logic lands; failing-first tests per milestone; noise discharge per ADR-031

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Immediate-form multiplier, commutative chain folding and direct guest binding of spare copy arguments

impact_assessment.why: Board-wide speed gap: many_params pays a constant register load plus two-operand imul for every homed*literal, chains park their accumulator and round-trip rax, and five-or-six-parameter copies park spare arguments in temporaries only to rebind them at copy entry.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every homed-name-times-constant lowers to one three-operand imul_r,rm,imm; every commutative chain folds into its destination register; spare copy arguments land directly in guest homes with the entry rebinds skipped.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: imul_imm must refuse imm32 overflow and the chain path must refuse shapes whose right side reads or clobbers the destination; dependency: codegen hooks only wrap existing lowering, no new module; concurrency: none, single-threaded compiler; state: benchmark history appends atomically as before.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first byte-level shape tests pin each lowering; full 897-test suite plus ADR-044 leaf-stability pins guard regressions; benchmark gate re-run with noise discharge per ADR-031.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Magic division seeds and divisors hoist into spare homes

impact_assessment.why: binary_gcd's main loop reloads four 64-bit constants (two seeds, two divisors) per iteration although the hoisting machinery exists and the loop has spare homes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every looped magic division reads its seed and divisor from hoisted registers; the guest planner stops borrowing hoisted homes, which also closes a latent corruption path for any hoisted loop containing a copy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: hoist_imm reads must stay guarded to the real body; dependency: only codegen; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first shape test pins the hoisted forms; pair and delta machine frames skip hoisting so r13 rebinds never collide; full suite plus benchmark gate.
